verdict.why: Wrangler now prompts to update installed Cloudflare agent skills after eligible commands, suppressible via an env var.

draft.detail: The WRANGLER_NO_SKILLS_UPDATE_PROMPTS=true environment variable can be used to suppress Wrangler skills update prompts.

source.quote: When declining an update, Wrangler offers the option to permanently disable future update prompts. This preference is stored globally in `~/.wrangler/agents-skills-install.jsonc`. The `WRANGLER_NO_SKILLS_UPDATE_PROMPTS=true` environment variable can also be used to suppress prompts.
